environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate. PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance with application database user 'configsvc' granted full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables in the 'public' schema. Application runs behind an NLB with no request filtering. JVM 17 with default security manager (disabled).

config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO configsvc
